named_question: How does the native display-name cell modify SName, and which input subset and explicit clear can be supported without approximating normalization?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Complete SName-specific normalizer: nonempty guard, transliteration, case conversion and character replacements.
Exact case conversion: ASCII lowercase is changed to uppercase; uppercase ASCII letters, digits and spaces are unchanged.
Full generic-normalizer argument tuple before all column-specific branches.
Actual row/cell data supplies the selected record, retained in R15.

source_contract.selected_field: Grid column7 commit calls the SName-specific normalizer and copies its result to selected record+0x30, separately bound as SName. Name at +0x18 is a different field.
source_contract.normalization: The common text normalizer runs first. The additional helper transliterates non-ASCII through a frozen table, applies uppercase conversion, replaces several punctuation bytes, and converts a degree representation. ASCII uppercase letters/digits and ordinary internal spaces avoid these transformations.
source_contract.clear: Unlike column0 Name, column7 copies the result without a nonempty guard. Empty input therefore clears the stored model string. The common type15 attribute reader copies its cleared temporary on missing input, so omission reads as empty, not inherited text.
source_contract.native_save_boundary: The native optional-string writer can omit empty SName. CLI clearing a nonempty SName stores an explicit empty attribute through the existing writer; either representation reads as empty. No byte-identical native serialization or hardware-display behavior is claimed.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-display-name FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME (--name NAME | --clear) [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.selection: Reuse exact direct-record metadata selection; no fuzzy matching, numeric-name ambiguity or nested decoys.
CLI_policy.new_name: Uppercase ASCII letters/digits with ordinary internal spaces and alphanumeric edges. Reject lowercase, edge spaces, punctuation/control and Unicode rather than silently uppercase, transliterate or sanitize.
CLI_policy.clear: CLI requires explicit --clear; --name must be nonempty. Clear changes only a nonempty SName to the empty string. Missing/already-empty SName is an exact-byte no-op in place; omission stays omitted.
CLI_policy.preservation: Only selected SName changes. Keep Name, all other records/attributes, IDs, flags, Qn, count/width/order, LSConfig, HCL, capabilities, sequences and unknown storage. Existing writer formatting and Document stamps retain normal behavior.

validation_scope.assumptions: Normal returns and valid objects. Selected-field transaction only, not complete Unicode normalization, dialog permissions, display inheritance, physical Touch Pure Flex rendering or accepted native save/reopen.
